title: Transfer restricted: CpToken__TransferNotAllowed
summary: Sourcify verified-selector match CpToken__TransferNotAllowed means token movement is blocked by lockup, soulbound, freeze, transfer-list, or compliance rules.
likelyCauses: The token or account is locked, frozen, soulbound, non-transferable, or blocked by transfer policy.
A vesting, cooldown, or lockup period has not expired.
Sender, receiver, or token id is not allowed by the token's compliance module.
nextSteps: Check transfer restrictions, lock expiry, frozen status, and allowlist or blocklist state for both parties.
Wait for lockup expiry or use an authorized transfer path if the token supports one.
Do not treat this as a gas issue; the transfer inputs or account status must change.
